text:
maya: Anyone else seeing blank scorecards when we import candidates with the privacy flag set? External interviewers get an empty page.

jordan: yep seen it. looks like the webhook is sending `candidate_privacy: true` and our frontend hides the scorecard when that exists.

sam: we ran into a similar rename issue last month when the ATS switched from `anonymized` -> `candidate_privacy`. mapping might not be updated for new import pipelines.

nina: can you paste an example payload?

maya: here's one I grabbed from a failing import: 
```
{"candidate_id": "C-12345", "name": "Redacted", "candidate_privacy": true, "scorecard_template_id": "tpl-789", "assigned_interviewers": ["leo@redwood.com"]}
```

leo: ok that explains it — our UI check is `if (payload.anonymized) hideScorecard()` so it didn't catch `candidate_privacy`. quick fix is to normalize fields in the webhook mapper.

elaine: ops question — what's the impact window? how many interviews affected?

jordan: initial query shows ~24 interviews in the last 12 hours where assigned_interviewers couldn't open the scorecard. most are external contractors.

maya: can we put a short-term workaround in place? interviewers are missing prep material.

leo: propose patch: update webhook transform to set `anonymized = anonymized || candidate_privacy` and reprocess the import queue for last 48h. I can ship the mapper change and a migration script.

jordan: I'll push the mapper patch at 16:00 PT, deploying to staging first. if all green, prod deploy at 17:30 PT and kick off reprocess.

nina: I'll create the backfill job and run on staging once patch is up, then run prod backfill after approval. backfill will only touch candidates created in the last 72h to limit blast radius.

ats-bot: created incident INC-2026-348 and notified #incidents and the affected interviewers list.

maya: perfect. please add a short note to the interviewers about where to find the prep while we reprocess (link: https://redwood.internal/prep).

sam: small ask — add a unit test to webhook mapper for both `anonymized` and `candidate_privacy` keys. saved us last time.

leo: yes will add tests.

elaine: thanks everyone. ping here once prod backfill is done and we can close INC-2026-348. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all :)
